subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: After verifying that `jasonacurry` created `xerg` and reviewing the organization’s membership audit history, should operators restore owner membership immediately while preserving the anomalous state for root-cause analysis?
rationale: Only an authorized operator can inspect production identity and audit records and approve the privilege-restoration step; repository evidence cannot safely establish entitlement by itself.

options.title: Verify and restore
options.body: Confirm creator identity and audit history, preserve the relevant records, restore owner membership, and investigate the mutation path afterward.

options.title: Hold pending evidence
options.body: Leave the role unchanged until production records or additional identity evidence establish that owner restoration is authorized.

recommendation.title: Verify and restore
recommendation.body: Confirm creator identity and audit history, preserve the relevant records, restore owner membership, and investigate the mutation path afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the introduction and documentation of the shared-publisher ownership model.
